boundary: This identifies the local representation-theoretic completion. It does not identify the selector correction-exchange character of Pass 1034 with chirality or with any global determinant character.
experimental_consequence: A scalar intensity measurement cannot retain the determinant phase under S3 inversion. The detector must preserve two real quadratures, or equivalently the conjugate pair (chi, chi-bar).

fusion_interpretation.preserved_relations: the diagonal, one 27-orbital, and the 36-orbital remain real

headline: The complex determinant is the oriented C3 phase character. Under the selector's S3 inversion it is exchanged with its complex conjugate and cannot remain a scalar character. Its unique S3 completion is the irreducible two-dimensional standard representation, exactly explaining the 1+1->2 and 27+27->54 fusion shadow.

s3_completion.reason: S3_ab = C2, so every scalar character is trivial on C3
